description: This file defines an Android activity named ContentInfoActivity that displays detailed information about media content. It includes UI initialization, handling of intent extras, focus management for remote control navigation, and stubbed event handlers for user actions.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that presents detailed content information including title, synopsis, image, tags, runtime, and action buttons, with focus management and intent-based data passing.

methods.name: buildIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch ContentInfoActivity, embedding content details and focus restore information as extras.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initialization of UI components, setting up focus navigation, populating views with intent extras, and attaching click handlers.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back key presses to deliver focus restore data before closing the activity.

methods.name: deliverFocusRestoreResult
methods.description: Prepares and sets the result intent with row and item indices for focus restoration on return.
